units.notes: I could not find the gas turbine maker or model. Project pages and trade press give only the 25 MW size and the steam turbine size. I did not guess a model.

qa.recommendation: Review the start year of 2023 and the capacity of 58 MW. Do not change them without more evidence.
qa.note: The INEOS Cologne project page says the plant went into operation in February 2025. GEM shows a start year of 2023. The regulator's plant list dated June 2026 shows two INEOS Manufacturing Deutschland units that may belong to this plant. One is a 32 MW natural gas unit from 2022 and one is a 38 MW unit from 2025. A consulting firm that worked on the project gives a 25 MW gas turbine and a 38 MW steam turbine, which adds up to 63 MW, not 58 MW. I could not tell which register rows match this plant, so I made no change.
